description: Port empire-remastered's ESF tools (rml_mod/tools/db/esf_dump, esf_edit, esf_diff, esf_map, test_esf_edit; method in its docs/plans/STATE_CONTROL.md section 2 and 4). Gate: byte-exact round trip on several Napoleon saves, no unknown tag. Map Napoleon record paths from pairs of saves one action apart (Liam makes them) into a SAVE_FORMAT doc with recipes; prove at least one scalar and one structural edit load in game through J3 autostart and survive an EndTurn. The parser is game-agnostic: flag it as a warscape-core candidate. Feeds J4 (generate mid- and late-game campaign states instead of playing to them).
title: Save editing: ESF tools and Napoleon save format
